firstDayWithUs: Today is his first day with us

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.name: Name
edit.foodHint: What he eats now, for example the brand and stage.
edit.aboutHint: His personality, what he loves, his quirks.
edit.homeBeforeBirth: He can't come home before he was born.

private.title: Private details
private.intro: Only you and the other editors can see this.
private.emptyBody: Add the microchip and the vet's contact to keep them handy.

settings.timezoneBody: Used for "today" and meal times. Only changed in the database.

meals.title: Meal schedule
meals.intro: Set the time of each meal. Grams are optional.
meals.noteHint: For example, what the bag or the vet recommends.

errors.timeDuplicate: Another meal already has this time.

export.title: Export data
export.intro: Download a copy of everything logged, including private details. Keep it somewhere safe.
export.csvIntro: Each table downloads as a CSV file that opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
export.failed: Couldn't load all the data. Check your connection and try again.

about.title: About the app
about.intro: Tyler Tracker is the family app for looking after Tyler.
about.installTitle: How to install it on your iPhone
about.install3: Choose "Add to Home Screen" and tap "Add".
about.install4: Open Tyler from the icon on your home screen.

memories.title: Memories
memories.teaserEmpty: Save his first times and photos to remember them forever.
memories.emptyBody: Tyler's moments and photos will show up here.
memories.emptyBodyEditor: Save his first moment with the + button or pick one of these.
memories.addMilestoneBody: A first time, with a story and photos.
memories.storyHint: Tell it the way you want to remember it.
memories.photosHint: You can pick several at once.

deleteMilestoneBody.one: Its photo will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
deleteMilestoneBody.other: Its {count} photos will be deleted too. This can't be undone.

memories.caption: Caption
memories.captionHint: Used for all the photos you pick.
memories.deletePhotoBody: It will be gone for good. This can't be undone.

theme.title: Theme
theme.savedDevice: Only changes the app for you, on this device.
theme.savedAccount: Only changes the app for you and is saved to your account.
theme.autoHint: Automatic follows your device's light or dark mode.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Alerts on this phone when a meal isn't logged on time, and the day before and the day of vaccines, dewormings, vet follow-ups and reminders.
push.enabled: Notifications turned on for this phone
push.disabled: Notifications turned off for this phone
push.mealsHint: At each meal time that isn't logged, and again 30 minutes later.
push.dueHint: At 8:00 AM the day before and on the day; reminders with a time, also at that time.
push.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
push.checkFailed: Couldn't check the notification status. Check your connection.

install.title: First, install the app on your iPhone
install.step1: In Safari, tap Share (the square with the arrow).
install.step3: Open Tyler from the icon on your Home Screen and come back here.
install.version: On iPhone, notifications only work in the installed app on iOS 16.4 or later.

unsupported.title: This browser can't receive notifications
unsupported.body: Use the app installed on your iPhone's Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later), or Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer or Android.

denied.title: Notifications are blocked
denied.body: You blocked alerts for this app. To turn them back on:
denied.step1: Open Settings on your iPhone and tap Notifications.
denied.step3: Come back to the app; this section updates by itself.

lost.title: This phone stopped getting alerts
lost.body: Permission is still on, but the subscription was lost (iOS sometimes cancels it). Tap the button to turn it back on.

errors.offline: You're offline. Connect and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.not_found: This phone is no longer registered. Turn it back on.
errors.gone: This phone no longer gets alerts. Turn it back on.
errors.too_many: Wait a few seconds before sending another test.
errors.push_failed: The notification service didn't accept the alert. Try again later.
errors.denied: Without permission we can't send you alerts.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
